description: This Java class, ControllerViewArtifactInfo, represents metadata about a controller view within the Apache OFBiz framework. It retrieves and manages information about specific controller view XML configurations, including related screens and request mappings.

classes.name: ControllerViewArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata about a controller view configuration within OFBiz, including its URL, view URI, associated screen, and request mappings.

methods.name: ControllerViewArtifactInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object by fetching view info map and associated screen for a given controller XML URL and view URI.

methods.name: getControllerXmlUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL of the controller XML file associated with this view.

methods.name: getViewUri
methods.description: Returns the view URI for this controller view.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Provides a human-readable display name for the view, including its location relative to the OFBiz home directory.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type string, which is 'Controller View'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the internal type identifier for this artifact, used within the framework.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this view, composed of the controller XML URL and view URI.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Provides the URL location of the controller XML file.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on controller XML URL and view URI.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the object's string representation.

methods.name: getRequestsThatThisViewIsResponseTo
methods.description: Retrieves a set of request artifacts that this view responds to.

methods.name: getScreenCalledByThisView
methods.description: Returns the screen widget info that this view calls, if any.
